system.title: Raibach Prompt Composer Catalog
system.versionNote: the version is the /v…/ segment of the catalogId — catalog.json declares no version field of its own
system.description: THE SCHEMA. What the server validates an A2UI payload against — an unknown component fails loud with HTTP 503. Three files in this repository are called some version of 'registry' — this is the validation schema, NOT the allowlist the AI reads and NOT the Figma map. The allowlist is frontend/src/shared/tag-registry.ts; the design relationship is frontend/src/components/registry.json.
system.ownerNote: The catalogue declares no owner field. Nothing in the repository says who owns a catalogue.
system.tokensNote: No token count exists anywhere: the catalogue, the manifest and the ledger carry none per element or per catalogue. The only token-ish numbers in the repository are session totals (tokenEstimate on two ledger records), which are not per-element and must not be shown as if they were.
system.categoryNote: No declared category exists (layout / components / actions are not in any file). The groups below are DERIVED from the allowlist's surface + column — the only grouping the repository actually states. A real layout/component/action category has to be DECLARED per element in the catalogue.
system.figmaLayersNote: Figma layers are not drawn: they need the design file and an API token. The Figma node each element came from is shown instead (registry.json), and the ingest ledger for it.
system.removalNote: 6 removal record(s) in backend/logs/figma-ingest.jsonl, and not one names a node or a tag. The ledger says a removal happened and what the audit counted afterwards; it does not say what was removed. The counts in those verdicts are the only trace (58 components before 01:10:49Z, 57 after 01:11:58Z).

findings.what: <chat-panel> dispatches "a2ui:write-seat", "insert-tool", "set-package-description", "merge-seat", "move-tool", "set-left-column-text", "a2ui:fix-all", "a2ui:run-approved", "set-prompt-title", "remove-prompt-role", "add-prompt-role", "clear-left-column", "ai-eval-grounding", "ai-show-version", "a2ui:console-command", "a2ui:system-message", "conversation-change", "a2ui:usage", "a2ui:run-blocked", "input-resize-move", "input-resize-end", "input-resize-start", "conversation-select" and the tag registry does not list it. The registry's `events` is read as EMITS by some callers and as a LISTENS-FOR list by others, which is why an unlisted dispatch is a gap and not an error.
findings.fix: List "a2ui:write-seat", "insert-tool", "set-package-description", "merge-seat", "move-tool", "set-left-column-text", "a2ui:fix-all", "a2ui:run-approved", "set-prompt-title", "remove-prompt-role", "add-prompt-role", "clear-left-column", "ai-eval-grounding", "ai-show-version", "a2ui:console-command", "a2ui:system-message", "conversation-change", "a2ui:usage", "a2ui:run-blocked", "input-resize-move", "input-resize-end", "input-resize-start", "conversation-select" on chat-panel in the registry — and say which direction the list means.

elements.name: prompt-section-editor

findings.what: <prompt-section-editor> dispatches "section-write-failed", "a2ui-update-error-banner", "a2ui:ask-grace" and the tag registry does not list it. The registry's `events` is read as EMITS by some callers and as a LISTENS-FOR list by others, which is why an unlisted dispatch is a gap and not an error.
findings.fix: List "section-write-failed", "a2ui-update-error-banner", "a2ui:ask-grace" on prompt-section-editor in the registry — and say which direction the list means.
